candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin no dey cough or get wahala to breathe. Di pikin no get diarrhoea. Di pikin get ear problem. Di pikin no get fever. Di pikin no dey convulse now. Dem no talk say di pikin don convulse before. Di pikin no dey weak or dey unconscious. Di pikin fit drink or suck breast. Di pikin no dey vomit everything. Dem report say discharge dey come out from ear. Di pikin no dey feel pain for ear. Pus dey comot from ear. Di pikin no get tender swelling for back of ear.
